$schema: THE ANNEX asset manifest — read by game code to know each GLB's sub-objects, pivots and suggested materials.

conventions.up_axis: +Y (glTF export; authored Z-up in Blender, exporter flips it)
conventions.pivots: floor-standing props: base centre. wall-mounted props: mounting face. hinged/rotating parts: the hinge/joint axis. See each asset's 'pivot' note.
conventions.materials: Every mesh has named MAT_* slots. The game re-materialises with its own procedural PBR library (src/world/Palette.js); 'suggestedPalette' below is the closest existing key per slot — several assets need NEW palette keys (glass, emissive, rubber, copper, brass) that don't exist yet, called out explicitly.

assets.description: Hand-carried ceramic-and-brass power core — the key puzzle item.
assets.pivot: root at the base of the ceramic body (floor/hand-carry convention); +Y is the model's 'front' (the window side).

subObjects.name: CeramicBody
subObjects.purpose: sharp-shouldered insulator-shed body with a recessed/bezelled window cutout

subObjects.name: _bezelFrame
subObjects.purpose: proud brass bezel around the glass window

subObjects.name: WindowScrews
subObjects.purpose: 4 corner fixing screws on the bezel

subObjects.name: BrassBase
subObjects.purpose: base cap with chamfered contact face

subObjects.name: _hexBase
subObjects.purpose: hex wrench-flat band on the base cap

subObjects.name: BaseRivets
subObjects.purpose: 6 fixings between base cap and ceramic body

subObjects.name: BrassProngs
subObjects.purpose: 3 contact prongs on the underside

subObjects.name: BrassTop
subObjects.purpose: top cap + contact stud

subObjects.name: _hexTop
subObjects.purpose: hex wrench-flat band on the top cap

subObjects.name: TopRivets
subObjects.purpose: 6 fixings between top cap and ceramic body

subObjects.name: Handle
subObjects.purpose: carry bail, static

subObjects.name: HandleLugs
subObjects.purpose: flattened drilled lugs where the handle hinges

subObjects.name: HingePins
subObjects.purpose: pins through the handle lugs

subObjects.name: Glass
subObjects.purpose: inspection window pane — needs a transmissive/glass shader

subObjects.name: Filament
subObjects.purpose: visible glowing filament behind the glass — drive its emission strength for puzzle state

subObjects.name: DataPlate
subObjects.purpose: stamped data plate with raised lettering bars + asset-tag boss

suggestedPalette.MAT_brass: chrome (NEEDS a dedicated brass/copper key — chrome reads too cool/blue)
suggestedPalette.MAT_glass: NEW KEY NEEDED — transmissive glass, none exists in Palette.js
suggestedPalette.MAT_emissive: NEW KEY NEEDED — emissive material the game can drive by strength for puzzle feedback

assets.description: Wall-mounted distribution board with a hinged door, DIN-railed interior, 8 breakers + main isolator, terminal block, wiring looms and a gland plate.
assets.pivot: root at the WALL MOUNTING FACE: x=0 (width centre), y=0 (back plane against the wall), z=0 (vertical centre of the box). Box extends +Y away from the wall.

subObjects.name: Enclosure
subObjects.purpose: outer steel shell, open-fronted cavity

subObjects.name: FrontLip
subObjects.purpose: rolled/folded lip around the front opening

subObjects.name: Backplate
subObjects.purpose: interior mounting plate

subObjects.name: Busbars
subObjects.purpose: 2 copper busbars

subObjects.name: DinRails
subObjects.purpose: top/bottom DIN rails the breakers clip onto

subObjects.name: InteriorDetail
subObjects.purpose: merged static detail: 8 breaker bodies + rating windows + test buttons, main isolator body/window, neutral/earth terminal block + screws, gland plate + gland rings
subObjects.material: mixed: MAT_switch_plastic / MAT_rating_window / MAT_terminal_block / MAT_steel_dark / MAT_din_rail

subObjects.name: switch_0 .. switch_7
subObjects.purpose: the 8 individually-pivoting BREAKER TOGGLE levers (hinge at the switch face; rotate about local X to flip). The static breaker bodies live in InteriorDetail.

subObjects.name: main_isolator
subObjects.purpose: larger pivoting isolator toggle, same convention as switch_N

subObjects.name: WiringLooms
subObjects.purpose: cable bundles from each breaker down to the gland plate

subObjects.name: Knockouts
subObjects.purpose: 3 conduit knockouts on the top face (1 punched-through, 2 still blanked)

subObjects.name: LabelPlate
subObjects.purpose: blank schematic label plate on the backplate

subObjects.name: pivot_door
subObjects.purpose: EMPTY at the hinge line (x=hinge_x). Rotate about local Z to open/close.

subObjects.name: DoorLeaf
subObjects.purpose: door leaf: return flange, hinge-knuckle set, stiffening ribs, card holder — child of pivot_door

subObjects.name: _latchDisc
subObjects.purpose: quarter-turn latch with a screwdriver slot — child of pivot_door

subObjects.name: ScheduleCard
subObjects.purpose: paper circuit schedule sitting in the door's card holder — child of pivot_door

suggestedPalette.MAT_copper_busbar: NEW KEY NEEDED — copper; chrome/conduitMetal are the closest existing metals
suggestedPalette.MAT_terminal_block: NEW KEY NEEDED — green terminal-block plastic

assets.description: Corroded cast-iron gate valve on a pipe stub with a separately-pivoting handwheel.
assets.pivot: root on the PIPE CENTRELINE (x=0 mid-length, y=0, z=0) so the game can slot it into a pipeRun. Pipe runs along local X.

subObjects.name: FlowBody
subObjects.purpose: the main valve body inline with the pipe

subObjects.name: PipeStubs
subObjects.purpose: pipe stubs + end flanges both sides

subObjects.name: Bonnet
subObjects.purpose: bonnet rising from the flow body to the stem

subObjects.name: BonnetBolts
subObjects.purpose: 8 fixing bolts around the bonnet flange

subObjects.name: Stem
subObjects.purpose: static stem rising to the wheel

subObjects.name: wheel
subObjects.purpose: THE PIVOTING PART — spoked handwheel with hex hub nut; rotates about the stem axis (local Z through its own origin at the stem top)

assets.pivot: origin at the centre of the hand grip. +Y is 'forward' (toward the bulb/cage); the hook hangs on -Z from the rear, the cable exits the rear cap toward -Y.

subObjects.name: Grip

subObjects.name: _rearcap
subObjects.purpose: steel cap closing the grip's back end

subObjects.name: _rearScrews

subObjects.name: _cableClamp

subObjects.name: switch_slide
subObjects.purpose: PIVOTING/SLIDING slide-switch nub (game should translate it along its slot, not rotate it)

subObjects.name: HeadHousing

subObjects.name: _ferrule

subObjects.name: _cageMounts

subObjects.name: _reflector

subObjects.name: Bulb

subObjects.name: Filament

subObjects.name: Hook
subObjects.purpose: static hanging hook

subObjects.name: CableStub

suggestedPalette.MAT_rubber_grip: NEW KEY NEEDED — matte black rubber; plenum is the closest non-metal dark surface
suggestedPalette.MAT_bulb_filament: NEW KEY NEEDED — emissive, drive by lamp on/off state
suggestedPalette.MAT_cable_rubber: NEW KEY NEEDED — matte black rubber (same as MAT_rubber_grip)

assets.description: First-person hands, stylised relaxed loose-carry pose. No rig — game poses procedurally.
assets.pivot: EACH hand's own local origin is its WRIST, with local -Z running from wrist toward fingertips. hand_L and hand_R are exported at x=-0.10/+0.10 for the contact-sheet render only — reposition/rotate each independently at runtime.

subObjects.name: hand_L
subObjects.purpose: left hand, mirrored geometry from the same build

subObjects.name: hand_R
subObjects.purpose: right hand

suggestedPalette.MAT_skin_stylised: NEW KEY NEEDED — stylised skin tone, nothing in Palette.js covers organic/skin surfaces

assets.description: THE SURVEYOR — THE ANNEX's entity. ~2.9m tall. Square louvred-diffuser head on a long neck with instrument-boom rods; irregular stacked ceiling-void-plate torso with a gap exposing its spine; long over-segmented arms ending in flat measuring paddles; thin legs reversed at the knee. Fully procedural joint hierarchy, neutral A-pose at rest.
assets.pivot: root at ground level between the feet. Every limb/joint object's LOCAL ORIGIN is its own joint (shoulder/elbow/wrist, hip/knee/ankle, torso base, neck base, head base) — verified non-zero in parent space; safe for direct procedural rotation.
assets.hierarchy: surveyor > torso > { neck > head, arm_upper_L > arm_lower_L > hand_L, arm_upper_R > arm_lower_R > hand_R }; surveyor > leg_upper_L > leg_lower_L > foot_L; surveyor > leg_upper_R > leg_lower_R > foot_R

subObjects.name: torso
subObjects.purpose: irregular stacked ceiling-void plates (one gap exposes the spine core), corner rivets, one sheared/damaged corner. Pivots at the hip line.

subObjects.name: neck
subObjects.purpose: thin shaft, torso to head base

subObjects.name: head
subObjects.purpose: the identifying silhouette feature: a solid-bordered square louvre plate (see-through only at its centre aperture) + instrument-boom rods behind it + corner fixing bolts. Slight tilt about its own facing normal.

subObjects.name: arm_upper_L / arm_upper_R
subObjects.purpose: shoulder-to-elbow segment, mounted high/wide, with a shoulder collar + clevis pin

subObjects.name: arm_lower_L / arm_lower_R
subObjects.purpose: elbow-to-wrist, built as TWO visual sub-segments (elbow->mid->wrist) inside one pivoting object for the 'too many segments' read, with elbow/mid collars + clevis pin

subObjects.name: hand_L / hand_R
subObjects.purpose: flat wide measuring-paddle terminal, wrist collar + clevis pin

subObjects.name: leg_upper_L / leg_upper_R
subObjects.purpose: hip-to-knee (thigh), hip collar + clevis pin

subObjects.name: leg_lower_L / leg_lower_R
subObjects.purpose: knee-to-ankle (shin), reversed-knee bend baked into the rest pose, knee collar + clevis pin

subObjects.name: foot_L / foot_R
subObjects.purpose: flat foot + ankle collar

suggestedPalette.MAT_void_plate: ceilingTile (strong thematic match — the torso literally is ceiling-void material)
suggestedPalette.MAT_louvre_grille: gridMetal (matches the building's own ceiling-grid material — reinforces the theme)

qa.silhouette_test: docs/assets/surveyor_silhouette.png (full / quarter-height / eighth-height, pure black on grey) — head remains the widest, most distinct silhouette feature at all three sizes

notPresent.note: Tier 3 fixtures/set-dressing (troffer, bulkhead_lamp, radiator, locker, pipe_junction, cart, office_chair, desk, crt_terminal, shelving_unit, duct_section, debris_kit) were not built this pass — Tier 1 + the Surveyor were prioritised per direction, and Tier 1 required two full rebuild passes to reach a manufactured-detail bar. Kit.js/geo.js already procedurally cover several of these shapes (troffer, grille, conduit) reasonably well in the meantime.
